_comment: Castalia-Quad (CQ) respin: the Castalia defaults with ONLY the package model changed to the CQ3b QFN64 quad pinout (16/side, 9x9 mm, 0.5 mm pitch, 4 per-quadrant analog domains, 16 electrode pads, 2 unbonded GPIO). Same tile RTL as the default build (MCU.vhd/MemoryMap are package-agnostic) -- only config/PadRing.json + the TRM pinout differ. See cq3b_generator_proposal.md / cq3b_pin_map.md. Build with: make chip CONFIG=config/cq.json
_defaultNote: 2026-08-16, USER DIRECTIVE -- READ THIS BEFORE USING THIS FILE FOR A BUILD: castalia-quad-qfn64 is now the SHIPPED DEFAULT package model (set in BOTH generate.py's _CONFIG_META entry and its _cfg call site, the two-places rule that check_config_defaults.py enforces). A bare `make chip` therefore already builds the QFN-64 chip, and the DEFAULT TRM is now the QFN-64 manual: it carries the QFN-64 pinout chapter and the Analog Front-End chapter (AFE0-3 + EIS) that this package model gates. This file is KEPT, on the wound.json / penta_wound.json precedent -- a named row that says out loud which chip it is, so a future default flip cannot silently re-base it, and so `make chip CONFIG=config/cq.json` keeps working. What it still CHANGES on top of the default is exactly one knob: package.preliminary=false, which suppresses the TRM's `Preliminary: the package model for this configuration has not been finalized' banner. The default leaves that banner ON (package.preliminary defaults true and was deliberately NOT flipped with the model -- whether a bond-out is confirmed is a different question from which pinout is documented). If the CQ64 bond-out is confirmed for the shipped chip, flip package.preliminary's default in generate.py (both places) and this file becomes fully redundant with the default. NOTE also that implementations/asic/castalia/docs/TRM_CQ64.pdf was deleted in the same change: the default manual IS that manual now.
_debugNote: 2026-08-17 PIN, the debug sibling of the package pin above and added for the same reason. Commit 00535af made debug.enable=true the SHIPPED DEFAULT (both the _CONFIG_META entry and the _cfg call site -- the two-places rule). This row pins a package model that bonds NO JTAG TAP, so inheriting that default makes generate.py's _checkDebugTransportBonded() a HARD ERROR: 'debug.enable is true but package model "castalia-quad-qfn64" bonds no JTAG TAP ... the DTM would be on-die and unreachable'. The row was unbuildable from 00535af until this line. Pinned, not changed -- debug-OFF is the shape this row already resolved to before the promotion (the DM is proven at N=5 by config/castalia_debug.json and at N=18 by config/argus_debug.json, both of which name a TAP-bearing package). The alternative fix -- moving this row to castalia-lqfp100 -- would change the chip this row exists to document.
